Class FixedBackOff

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.util.backoff.FixedBackOff
All Implemented Interfaces:
BackOff
public class FixedBackOff extends Object implements BackOff
一个简单的BackOff实现，它提供两次尝试之间的固定间隔和最大重试次数。
Since:
4.1
Author:
Stephane Nicoll, Sam Brannen
